meta.name: metabase_ingest
meta.description: Convert Metabase questions, models, and metrics into ktx Semantic Layer source definitions. Covers result-metadata to KSL column type mapping, FK/PK detection, near-duplicate deduplication, pre-aggregation decomposition, join-graph connectivity, and how to react to priorProvenance from earlier ingest syncs. Load when the WorkUnit contains `cards/<id>.json` files under a Metabase bundle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Metabase 分析内容转为语义层定义
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在把 Metabase 卡片迁移到 ktx 语义层
copy.tagline_en: Convert Metabase questions into semantic layer definitions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if migrating Metabase cards to ktx semantic layer

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能读取 Metabase 导出的卡片（问题、模型、指标），自动将其转换为 ktx 语义层的数据源定义，包括列类型映射、主外键检测、去重、预聚合分解和连接图处理。
howto.when: 当工作单元包含 Metabase 包中的 `cards/<id>.json` 文件时触发。

say.text: 请处理这个 Metabase 卡片，生成语义层源。
say.note: Claude 会分析卡片并创建或更新源。

say.text: 帮我合并这些近似的卡片为一个通用源。
say.note: Claude 会去重并生成一个覆盖所有变体的源。

say.text: 检查这个卡片是否已有对应的源，有则编辑。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read Metabase exported cards (questions, models, metrics) and automatically convert them into ktx Semantic Layer source definitions, including column type mapping, FK/PK detection, deduplication, pre-aggregation decomposition, and join-graph connectivity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the WorkUnit contains `cards/<id>.json` files under a Metabase bundle.

say_en.text: Process this Metabase card and generate a semantic layer source.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the card and create or update a source.

say_en.text: Merge these near-duplicate cards into one generalized source.
say_en.note: Claude will deduplicate and produce a single source covering all variants.

say_en.text: Check if this card already has a source; edit it if so.
say_en.note: Claude will query priorProvenance and decide whether to create or edit.
